subject.title: feat(talk): describe_view inline vision for OpenAI Realtime + Gemini Live

question: Should OpenClaw accept browser-direct Video Talk `describe_view` for OpenAI WebRTC and Gemini Live, and what exact camera permission scope should be allowed?
rationale: Automation can identify the code defects and missing proof, but allowing camera capture and provider-direct image delivery is a product and security boundary decision that affects Gateway headers and provider behavior.

options.title: Approve Narrow Scoped MVP
options.body: Require the branch to keep global camera denial, add a Control UI-only camera permission path, align provider denial behavior, rebase onto current Talk paths, and provide redacted real browser/provider proof before merge.

options.title: Pause For Transport Design
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader provider/Gateway video-frame transport design at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89131 is accepted or rejected.

options.title: Reject Browser-Direct Vision For Now
options.body: Close or substantially narrow the PR if maintainers do not want camera-derived frames in realtime Talk until a different security model exists.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Scoped MVP
recommendation.body: Require the branch to keep global camera denial, add a Control UI-only camera permission path, align provider denial behavior, rebase onto current Talk paths, and provide redacted real browser/provider proof before merge.
